abstract: Four cases with non-seminomatous testicular tumor in stage III completed chemotherapy with POMB/ACE. Of these 4 cases, metastasis to retroperitoneal lymph nodes was found in all of them. In addition, metastasis to the lung was noted in 3, and to the left supraclavicular lymph nodes in one. After orchiectomy, 5 courses of POMB/ACE therapy were given to each of the 4 cases. Tumor marker returned to normal value in all of the cases after 3-4 courses of treatment, with disappearance of metastasis to the lung and supraclavicular lymph nodes. However, the response rate in metastasis to retroperitoneal lymph nodes was CR in one case, and PR in 3. Therefore, retroperitoneal lymph nodes were excised in all 3 cases. Histologically, 2 of the 3 were found to have necrotic tissues. The remaining one patient had teratoma. An additional 1-3 courses of POMB/ACE therapy were given to these 3 cases. These 4 cases are alive without recurrence 6 years and 4 months, 5 years and 8 months, 4 years and 9 months, and 2 years 9 months, respectively, after orchiectomy. Thus POMB/ACE therapy is considered to be a useful method in the treatment of advanced testicular tumor.
abstract_ja: 病期III非セミノーマ性精巣腫瘍の4例にPOMB/ACE療法を完遂した。4例とも後腹膜リンパ節転移を認めた。さらに3例で肺転移、1例で左鎖骨上窩リンパ節転移を認めた。精巣摘除術後、4例それぞれにPOMB/ACE療法を5コース投与した。3～4コース後には全例で腫瘍マーカーが正常値に復し、肺転移および鎖骨上窩リンパ節転移は消失した。しかし後腹膜リンパ節転移の奏効は、1例でCR、3例でPRであった。そのため3例全例で後腹膜リンパ節切除を行った。組織学的には、3例のうち2例に壊死組織を認め、残る1例には奇形腫が認められた。これら3例にはさらにPOMB/ACE療法を1～3コース追加した。この4例は精巣摘除後、それぞれ6年4か月、5年8か月、4年9か月、2年9か月にわたり再発なく生存している。したがって、POMB/ACE療法は進行精巣腫瘍の治療に有用な方法と考えられる。
